how.title: Guess. Find out. Keep the card.

step1.title: Guess first
step1.body: Every lesson opens with a question you answer before you know. Being wrong is the point — it’s what makes the answer stick.

step2.title: Find out, in three minutes
step2.body: Short cards, one idea each. Complete the sentence, put steps in order, match a taste to its cause.

step3.title: Keep the card
step3.body: A perfect lesson earns a Coffee Card. Finish a module and its Module Reward joins your deck. Your tree grows either way.

card0.prompt: How many seeds sit inside a typical coffee cherry?
card0.explain: Two flat-faced seeds sit pressed together inside each cherry. A “peaberry” is the rare cherry that grew only one — which is why it’s rounder.

card1.statement: Arabica and robusta are two roasts of the same bean
card1.explain: False — they are two different species of coffee plant. Roast is what happens later, to either one.

card2.prompt: Which grows best high up a mountain?
card2.explain: Arabica prefers cool altitude — often 1,200 m and up. The slower ripening packs in more sugar, which is why it tastes sweeter.

roasty.title: Meet Roasty. He takes it personally.
roasty.body: A coffee bean with a beanie and strong opinions. He cheers a right answer, winces at a wrong one, and dozes off if you leave him too long. Dress him in the Studio — hats, glasses, a sprout.

faq.title: Things people ask before downloading.

q1.a: The first module — Beans, seven lessons — and the daily practice games are free, forever. Foundations unlocks the other four modules for a single payment. Nothing renews.

q2.a: No. The lessons are about understanding what happens to coffee, not about owning gear. The optional brew challenges use whatever is already in your kitchen.

q3.a: Not yet. BrewPath is iPhone-only for now; Android is on the plan. Write to us from the support page and we’ll tell you when.

q4.a: Yes. Everything is on your phone — lessons, dictionary, your progress. Planes and bad café Wi-Fi are fine.

q5.q: What exactly is a Coffee Card?
q5.a: A collectible you earn by finishing a lesson with a perfect score. Each one holds a fact, a specimen drawing and the spec of what you learned. There are 37, including a Module Reward for each of the five modules. You can share any card with a link.

faq.more: Something else? <link>Write to us</link> — a human answers, usually the same day.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms are the agreement between you and BrewPath when you use the app or this website. We tried to write them the way we write the lessons: short, plain, and honest.

ps.p1: By downloading or using BrewPath you agree to these terms and to our Privacy Policy. If you don’t agree, please don’t use the app.
ps.p2: You must be at least 13 years old, or the minimum age in your country, to use BrewPath.

ps.p1: BrewPath is a learning app. The first module and the daily practice games are free. “Foundations” unlocks the rest of the course and is sold as a one-time in-app purchase through Apple’s App Store.
ps.p2: There is no account. Your progress lives on your device. If you delete the app, your progress goes with it unless you have a device backup.

ps.p1: All purchases are processed by Apple under its terms. Prices are shown in the App Store in your local currency and may change.
ps.p2: You can restore a purchase on any device signed in to the same Apple Account from Profile → Restore purchases. Refund requests go through Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com; we can’t issue them directly.

ps.p1: Lesson text, illustrations, Roasty, the cards and the BrewPath name are ours or licensed to us. You may use them for your own learning and share cards with friends through the app’s share feature. Please don’t copy, resell or republish the course.
Don’t try to break the app, bypass a purchase, or use it in a way that harms others. We may stop providing BrewPath to anyone who does.

We work hard to keep lessons accurate and up to date, but coffee is a craft with many opinions. BrewPath is provided “as is”; we aren’t liable for a bad cup, a ruined bag of beans, or any indirect loss arising from your use of the app.
We may update these terms as the app grows. The date at the top tells you when. Continuing to use BrewPath after a change means you accept the new terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: BrewPath is built to work without an account and without following you around. This policy explains the little data the app does handle, and who sees it.

ps.p1: Your lessons, cards, streak, saved terms, Roasty’s outfit and the growth of your tree are stored on your device only. We can’t see them. There is no sign-up, no email, no password.
ps.p2: The first name you may give Roasty is used to greet you and never leaves the device.

ps.p1: Purchases. When you buy Foundations, Apple processes the payment. A purchase receipt and an anonymous app-user id are sent to RevenueCat, the service that confirms what you own and lets you restore it. We never see your card details.
ps.p2: Crash reports. If the app crashes, an anonymised report (device model, iOS version, the error) is sent to Firebase Crashlytics so we can fix it.
ps.p3: Paywall views. Whether the paywall was shown and whether a purchase followed is counted, anonymously, so we can price the course fairly.

ps.p1: We don’t sell data. We don’t run third-party advertising. We don’t track you across other apps or websites, and we don’t ask for App Tracking permission because we have no use for it.
When you share a card, the app creates a link to a page on this site showing that card. The link contains the card id and nothing else. Anyone with the link can see it.
Reset progress from Profile → Reset progress. Delete everything by deleting the app. To ask us to remove purchase records held by RevenueCat, email us from the device that made the purchase.
BrewPath is not directed at children under 13 and we knowingly collect no personal data from them.
If this policy changes in a way that matters, the app will tell you. Questions: {email}.

press.title: BrewPath, in one paragraph and a few files.
press.body: BrewPath is a coffee-learning app for iPhone. Short lessons and mini-games teach the craft of coffee — beans, processing, roasting, grind and brew — while a living tree and a collectible deck mark your progress. Roasty, a coffee bean with a beanie, comes along. The first module is free; the full course is a single purchase.
press.note: Please don’t recolour Roasty, stretch the icon, or set the name as “Brew Path”. It’s one word.
